name: CloudsmithCliSetupAndAuthenticate
description: Installs the Cloudsmith CLI and authenticates using API Key or OIDC.
helpMarkDown: Use this task to install and authenticate the Cloudsmith CLI during your Azure DevOps pipeline. For issues, contact: support@Cloudsmith.io
author: Cloudsmith Ltd (support@Cloudsmith.io)

inputs.name: oidcAuthOnly
inputs.label: OIDC Auth Only (skip installation)
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, the task will only authenticate via OIDC and export CLOUDSMITH_API_KEY. It will NOT install or verify the CLI.

inputs.name: cliVersion
inputs.label: Cloudsmith CLI Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Specify the version of Cloudsmith CLI to install (e.g., '0.25.0'). Leave empty to install the latest version.

inputs.name: authMethod
inputs.label: Authentication Method
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select your preferred authentication method. Use 'apiKey' for API Key-based authentication or 'oidc' for OpenID Connect (OIDC).

inputs.name: clientId
inputs.label: Azure Client ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provide the Azure Client ID for OIDC authentication.

inputs.name: clientSecret
inputs.label: Azure Client Secret
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provide the Azure Client Secret for OIDC authentication.

inputs.name: appIdUri
inputs.label: Azure Application ID URI
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provide the Azure Entra Application ID URI for scope defining.

inputs.name: tenantId
inputs.label: Azure Tenant ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provide the Azure Tenant ID for OIDC authentication.

inputs.name: oidcNamespace
inputs.label: OIDC Namespace
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provide the Cloudsmith organisation/namespace for OIDC.

inputs.name: oidcServiceSlug
inputs.label: OIDC Service Account Slug
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provide the Cloudsmith service account slug for OIDC.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: Cloudsmith API Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provide the Cloudsmith API key if API Key authentication is selected.
